subject: Biology
title: Structural Organisation in Animals
summary: Animal tissues chaar type ke hain: epithelial (dhakne wale), connective (support aur jodne wale), muscular (movement) aur neural (control).

Epithelia simple ya compound hote hain aur squamous, cuboidal, columnar ya ciliated ho sakte hain; glands secretion ke liye specialised epithelial cells hain. Cell junctions (tight, adhering, gap) cells ko jodte hain.
Connective tissue mein loose aur dense connective tissue, cartilage, bone, blood aur adipose tissue aate hain. Muscles skeletal, smooth ya cardiac hoti hain.
Frog (Rana tigrina) ko model vertebrate ki tarah padhte hain: morphology, digestive, respiratory (respiration), circulatory, excretory, nervous aur reproductive (reproduction) systems.

formulas.name: Simple epithelium
formulas.formula: squamous — blood vessel walls, air sacs of lungs;  cuboidal — ducts of glands, PCT of nephron (brush border);  columnar — stomach and intestine lining (microvilli);  ciliated — bronchioles, fallopian tubes

formulas.name: Compound epithelium
formulas.formula: multi-layered; protective (skin, buccal cavity, pharynx, ducts of salivary and pancreatic glands)
formulas.when: Jahan chemical aur mechanical stress se bachav chahiye.

formulas.name: Glands
formulas.formula: exocrine (with ducts — saliva, mucus, milk, earwax, digestive enzymes);  endocrine (ductless — hormones into blood)

formulas.name: Cell junctions
formulas.formula: tight junctions stop leakage;  adhering junctions cement cells together;  gap junctions connect cytoplasm for rapid transfer of ions and small molecules

formulas.name: Connective tissue types
formulas.formula: loose: areolar (under skin), adipose (fat);  dense regular: tendons (muscle → bone), ligaments (bone → bone);  dense irregular: skin;  specialised: cartilage, bone, blood

formulas.name: Cartilage and bone
formulas.formula: cartilage: chondrocytes in lacunae, pliable matrix (nose tip, outer ear, between vertebrae);  bone: osteocytes in lacunae, hard matrix of calcium salts and collagen; bone marrow makes blood cells

formulas.name: Muscle types
formulas.formula: skeletal: striated, voluntary, multinucleate;  smooth: non-striated, involuntary, spindle-shaped (gut, blood vessels);  cardiac: striated, involuntary, branched, intercalated discs

formulas.name: Neural tissue
formulas.formula: neurons (excitable) + neuroglia (support and protect; more than half the volume of neural tissue)

formulas.name: Frog heart and blood
formulas.formula: 3 chambers (2 atria + 1 ventricle) + sinus venosus + conus arteriosus;  RBCs nucleated;  hepatic portal and renal portal systems

formulas.name: Frog respiration
formulas.formula: skin (cutaneous) in water and during hibernation/aestivation;  buccal cavity and lungs on land

formulas.name: Frog excretion
formulas.formula: ureotelic;  kidneys → ureters → cloaca;  in males the ureter is a urinogenital duct; in females ureters and oviducts open separately into the cloaca

formulas.name: Frog nervous system
formulas.formula: 10 pairs of cranial nerves;  brain = forebrain (olfactory lobes, cerebral hemispheres, diencephalon), midbrain (optic lobes), hindbrain (cerebellum, medulla oblongata)

formulas.name: Frog reproduction
formulas.formula: external fertilisation in water;  development via tadpole larva (metamorphosis);  female lays 2500–3000 ova at a time

examples.title: Tendon vs ligament
examples.problem: Tendon kise jodta hai aur ligament kise?
examples.solution: Tendon: skeletal muscle ko bone se. Ligament: bone ko bone se. Dono dense regular connective tissue hain.

examples.title: Kaunsi muscle?
examples.problem: Ek muscle striated, branched aur involuntary hai, intercalated discs ke saath. Kaunsa type?
examples.solution: Cardiac muscle — intercalated discs (gap junctions wali judi plasma membranes) cells ko ek unit ki tarah contract karne dete hain.

examples.title: Brush border
examples.problem: Brush border wala cuboidal epithelium kahan milta hai?
examples.solution: Nephron ke proximal convoluted tubule (PCT) mein; microvilli reabsorption ke liye surface badhaate hain.

examples.title: Frog ki skin
examples.problem: Frog ki skin hamesha geeli kyun rehti hai?
examples.solution: Mucous glands ise geela rakhte hain, aur paani mein aur hibernation aur aestivation ke dauraan cutaneous respiration (skin se gas exchange) ke liye geela rehna zaroori hai.

examples.title: Male ya female frog?
examples.problem: Male frog ko female se kaise pehchaanoge?
examples.solution: Males mein vocal sacs aur har forelimb ki pehli ungli par copulatory pad hota hai; females mein dono nahi.

examples.title: Areolar tissue
examples.problem: Areolar tissue mein kaunse cells hote hain?
examples.solution: Fibroblasts (fibres banate hain), macrophages aur mast cells, semi-fluid ground substance mein collagen aur elastic fibres ke saath.

topics.title: Organ and organ system
topics.explain: Tissues milkar organs (stomach, lung, heart, kidney) banate hain; organs milkar organ systems (digestive, respiratory). Organ aur organ systems ki complexity evolution mein ek pehchaanne layak trend dikhati hai.

topics.title: Blood
topics.explain: Fluid connective tissue: plasma + formed elements (RBCs, WBCs, platelets). Ye main circulating fluid hai jo substances ko transport karta hai.

topics.title: Frog morphology
topics.explain: Body head aur trunk mein bati; gardan aur poonch nahi. Skin chikni aur fisalne wali; dorsal side olive green dark spots ke saath, ventral side halki peeli. Frogs paani peete nahi, skin se absorb karte hain. Camouflage (mimicry) dikhate hain aur cold-blooded (poikilothermous) hain.

topics.title: Frog digestive system
topics.explain: Chhota alimentary canal (frogs carnivores hain). Bilobed tongue insects pakadti hai. Liver bile banata hai (gall bladder mein store); pancreas pancreatic juice. Digestion intestine mein poora hota hai; food villi aur microvilli se absorb. Bina pacha waste cloaca se bahar.

topics.title: Frog sense organs
topics.explain: Sense organs: touch (sensory papillae), taste (taste buds), smell (nasal epithelium), vision (eyes) aur hearing (tympanum aur internal ear). Eyes aur internal ears achhe se organised; baaki nerve endings ke aas-paas cells ke jhund hain.

topics.title: Endocrine glands in frog
topics.explain: Pituitary, thyroid, parathyroid, thymus, pineal body, pancreatic islets, adrenals aur gonads.

ratta: Squamous — air sacs;  cuboidal — PCT;  columnar — gut;  ciliated — bronchioles, fallopian tube.
Tight stops leakage;  adhering cements;  gap connects cytoplasm.
Frog: 3-chambered heart, nucleated RBCs, 10 cranial nerves, ureotelic.
Male frog: vocal sacs + copulatory pad.
